{{Top|leg}}
The '''Queen of the Red''' was a title that was held by one of the three [[Quesoth]] [[Queen/Legends|Queens]], the rulers of the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Quesoth underwent a cycle whereby the Queen of the Red would reign from the [[Red City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]] for a number of years until her [[Death/Legends|death]] in a process known as the "changing of the air." She would then be replaced by the [[Queen of the White]] and on the White Queen's death, the [[Queen of the Black]] would emerge. The Queen of the Black would then, in turn, be replaced by the Queen of the Red, and the process would repeat itself.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|reigning Queen of the Red]] made a pact with the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] whereby Esva would aide her in murdering the Queen of the White, to allow her to rule forever, However, Quethold was subsequently [[Attack on the Red City|attacked]] by the forces of the [[Empire of the Hand]] and both Esva and the Queen of the Red died during the battle.
